highlights.title: Discussions tuck into the reader
highlights.description: Minimized discussions become bookmark capsules in the reader. Open one to restore the window and unsent reply, or drag them to a corner.

highlights.title: Highlight, revise, and export
highlights.description: Highlight in one click and search with ⌘F. Edit your thoughts, recolor single highlights, and export notes or distillations as Markdown.

highlights.title: Organize the library faster
highlights.description: Drag files onto the library to import them, sort by progress or annotations, filter by reading status, and relink missing source files.

highlights.title: Bilingual PDFs and a dark filter
highlights.description: Translate single-column text PDFs page by page over the original. Use the dark eye-care filter at night and shortcuts to zoom.

highlights.title: Clear assistant errors
highlights.description: Failures name the key, balance, rate-limit, or network cause, with one-click retry. Reader Q&A can stop and switch sessions; OpenRouter and more are preset.

highlights.title: Reliable backups, sync, and quitting
highlights.description: Back up and restore while sync or imports run, and quit without hangs. PDF imports no longer slow the interface, and switching assistants keeps replies.
